preconditions.description: The input `s` must be a string with length between 0 and 1000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i + 1, len(s) + 1) if s[i:j] == s[i:j][::-1])
postconditions.description: The output is the total count of all palindromic substrings in `s`, where a substring is defined as a contiguous sequence of characters. A substring is palindromic if it reads the same forwards and backwards.
